info.title: Agent Web Map API
info.description: AgentWebMap indexes websites publishing llms.txt and helps AI agents find publisher documentation through a free JSON API and MCP server, with source links, matching evidence, check dates and change notifications. Reads need no key. Compact fields are the default; detail=full includes owner metadata. Ownership verification proves identity, not documentation correctness. MCP server: https://agentwebmap.com/mcp

get.summary: API endpoints, discovery links and limits
Find publisher documentation for a domain or development task
get.description: Inspect match strength and health before using sources. Excerpts are publisher link metadata, not fetched page contents. Weak matches are fallback candidates; no matches return best=null. Live refresh validates without changing the directory.

parameters.name: capability
parameters.description: Publisher-declared MCP endpoint. This declaration does not prove endpoint availability or protocol compatibility.

parameters.name: max_age
parameters.description: Health age threshold in seconds; stale results remain visible and are marked.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Validate the selected source live. Rate limited to 20 per 10 minutes per client, cached/coalesced for 60 seconds per domain.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum documentation sources

get.summary: Topic taxonomy, classified site counts and publisher-declared capabilities
get.description: Counts cover featured/listed sites. Categories are inferred from publisher metadata and can overlap. Empty categories means unclassified. MCP capability requires an explicit publisher endpoint link; availability is not checked. Full domain detail includes category and capability evidence.
